description:
[Merchant] A placement's results over [from, to): offers shown when a bank resolved its ID (resolutions), offers shown after a recognised soundbite tap (recognitions), payments started (transactions) and confirmed, and confirmed amounts by currency.

**Endpoint:** GET /products/{productId}/placements/{placementId}/stats (PRM plan)

from.description: Start of the period: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, the start of that day in UTC) or an ISO-8601 instant with an offset, e.g. 2026-10-19T00:00:00+03:00. Default: 30 days before to

placementId.description: The placement's ID: pl + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pl7e4rCToG

productId.description: The product's ID: pr + 8 letters or digits, e.g. pr7e4rCToG

to.description: End of the period, exclusive, in the same forms. Default: now. At most 400 days after from

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_get_placement_stats
